title: Flight chaos caused by software defect in space of a millisecond, report says
description: The failure led to more than 2,000 flights being cancelled and hundreds of thousands of passengers affected.

title: MI5 accepts it gave evidence based on lies in neo-Nazi spy case
description: It is the first time MI5 has confirmed the BBC's revelation that it gave evidence based on lies in court while defending the violent informant.

title: Russian hybrid attacks against Europe intensifying, says Macron
description: The French president says he has tasked the government with protecting critical infrastructure and defence industry sites.

title: Women told breasts removed needlessly as NHS trust finds more than 300 suffered harm
description: The trust's new chief executive says he apologises unreservedly - "What happened was utterly unacceptable."

title: British rapper Sway dies aged 44
description: Sway, whose hits included Still Speedin' and Level Up, was living in Ghana at the time of his death.

title: Sisters of 'Putney pusher' suspect say DNA will clear his name
description: Nicholas Brandram's sisters tell the BBC he did a DNA test to speed up the inquiry but never got the results.

title: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
description: The military and government say the risk of conflict is growing, but we may not be mentally ready for it

title: 'Insufficient funds' to pay Brewdog creditors and unpaid wages after takeover deal
description: Administrators say about £489,000 was owed for staff wages and holiday pay and £2.4m was owed to HMRC for unpaid VAT.

title: Lindsay Clancy holdout juror says he had no doubt she deliberately killed her children
description: It is the first time the juror, who refused to side with the others and acquit Clancy, has spoken publicly about his decision.
